posts.cooked:
Missingno:

I’m sorry, how did you get to 23 incapped heroes in one game?

Really bad luck. Oblivaeon played cards like global devastation and tear through reality on phase 1, which hit really hard with a plus 5 damage boost. Nonetheless the heroes were able to successfully clear the shield. After that, twice, when Oblivaeon had 12+ tokens I moved my team to the other zone only for the scion deck to switch his zone and incap my full team.

posts.name: Dandolo
posts.cooked:
Another unfortunate game ending issue. Late in phase 2 the game froze and couldn't be reloaded.

The game was quite possibly headed for a hero win as I had only lost 1 environment so far. Though I was pretty likely to lose 2 more in the next round (13 devistation and the countdown at 1 with Oblivaeon at 60 HP). I had a fresh team of heroes after a full board incapacitation.

 

I'm going to tally the game as a win since I believe that was the more likely outcome even if it was by no means a lock.
